title.zh: OpenAI Asks Congress Whether an AI Slowdown Would Be Legal
title.en: OpenAI Asks Congress Whether an AI Slowdown Would Be Legal

current_state.zh: OpenAI has asked Congress whether rival AI companies could legally coordinate a slowdown in development, as its chief scientist calls for shared safety standards and a bill aims to protect certain AI-restricting agreements.
current_state.en: OpenAI has asked Congress whether rival AI companies could legally coordinate a slowdown in development, as its chief scientist calls for shared safety standards and a bill aims to protect certain AI-restricting agreements.
